1.title: Epstein 'mistakes' and Trump ties: Key takeaways from Todd Blanche's confirmation hearing
1.summary: Blanche faced bipartisan questioning on Wednesday as he seeks to take on the role of US attorney general permanently.

2.title: What to Know About Todd Blanche’s Order Granting Trump Immunity From I.R.S. Audits
2.summary: Acting attorney general Todd Blanche’s decision to grant President Trump protection from I.R.S. audits was a central issue in his confirmation hearing on Wednesday.

3.title: Trump Pressures ICE to Resume Traffic Stops After They Were Halted Over Fatal Shootings
3.summary: Immigration and Customs Enforcement had ordered its officers to halt most vehicle stops across the country after they shot two people over the past week.

4.title: Wildfires Rage in Ontario as Smoke Affects Toronto’s Air Quality
4.summary: Air quality in Canada’s largest city was at times the worst in the world on Wednesday, as wildfires across Ontario sent smoke drifting into New York City and beyond.

5.title: France Votes to Allow Assisted Dying
5.summary: Lawmakers approved a bill that will allow doctors to help terminally ill patients to die, adding France to a short list of nations that allow the practice.

6.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Exchange Strikes for Fifth Straight Day
6.summary: The United States launched fresh attacks against Iranian targets on Wednesday, hours after Iran targeted American military sites in the region. Neither side has shown signs of backing down in opening a new stage of the war.
